filament_notes:
Sensory ball - PLA on a stock Creality Ender 3 Pro (Bowden tube, stock hotend, 0.4 mm nozzle).

Starting values. Run the calibration guide (docs/3-calibrate.md) and replace them with your own:
  nozzle temperature   195 C (205 C first layer)  <- temperature tower
  flow ratio           0.98                       <- flow rate test
  retraction           5 mm @ 40 mm/s             <- retraction test
  max volumetric speed 12 mm3/s                   <- max flowrate test

Anti-stringing: wipe OFF and z-hop OFF are deliberate. Keep them off.
Source: https://github.com/fruch/sensory-ball-print
name: PLA Sensory Ball @Ender3Pro
